propositions: empty file_impact is overloaded between 'author forgot' and 'no file impact'; a third explicit state is needed to disambiguate
FILE_IMPACT event payload must gain file_impact_scope enum (undeclared/paths/none) and no_file_impact_reason string to support mutual-exclusivity enforcement in process_file_impact
set-file-impact CLI command must migrate from _REGISTRY to _ARGV_REGISTRY and support both array form (unchanged) and --none form with reason validation (minimum 10 non-whitespace chars)
get_file_impact_scope library function must return tri-state kind with reason and paths, and declare_no_file_impact tool must enforce same reason validation as CLI without writing on validation error
reducer state transitions between any pair of {undeclared, paths, none} must deterministically derive file_impact_scope and clear/populate no_file_impact_reason according to payload
rebar show must surface file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason for tickets with explicit no-file-impact declaration
